name: lumina
description: Lumina — Your Autonomous Chief of Staff

scripts.start:all: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && concurrently -k -n mcp,vite,app -c magenta,yellow,cyan "(lsof -nP -iTCP:9515 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[mcp] already running on :9515' && sleep infinity || (cd ${MCP_SERVER_DIR:-../mcp-server} && npm run dev:mcp))" "vite" "wait-on -t 90000 tcp:127.0.0.1:9515 http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.start:full: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && concurrently -k -n mcp,graph,vite,app -c magenta,green,yellow,cyan "(lsof -nP -iTCP:9515 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[mcp] already running on :9515' && sleep infinity || (cd ${MCP_SERVER_DIR:-../mcp-server} && npm run dev:mcp))" "(lsof -nP -iTCP:9516 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[graph] already running on :9516' && sleep infinity || (cd ../context_graph_v1 && npm run mcp:serve))" "vite" "wait-on -t 90000 tcp:127.0.0.1:9515 http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
